capabilities: Evaluate spreadsheet-style formulas in table cells marked with {{calc}}
Reference cells and ranges using A1 notation
Compute durations and clock times with unit-aware arithmetic
Render results inline in Live Preview and Reading view
Keep formulas as plain text in the Markdown source
extras: The README carries a prominent disclaimer that this is a hobby project not intended for medical, legal, financial, or other critical calculations, and the manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Formulas are never rewritten in the source, so notes stay portable with raw formulas visible when the plugin is disabled.
problem: Markdown tables are static text, so any totals or derived values must be computed by hand or in a separate spreadsheet and pasted back in.

relations.evidence: Typed results (duration ÷ duration is a number, end − start is a duration) follow the same rules as Apple Numbers' Duration type

summary: Spreadsheet formula engine for Markdown tables that evaluates =SUM, =AVERAGE, and arithmetic in opt-in cells and renders results inline.
